title: Sample house style: Chinese version of a listed company's quarterly report

rules.rule: Full-width Chinese punctuation throughout (，。：；（）“ ”); half-width only inside figures, registration numbers and RM'000.
Amounts in RM million become 万令吉 (or 亿令吉 from RM100 million), converted exactly: RM12.50 million = 1,250万令吉; RM250.00 million = 2.5亿令吉.
Percentages keep the two decimals of the English (21.12%, 25.00%).
A defined term is placed in “ ” inside full-width brackets at first use, then used without marks.
The company's short name 德拉斯 is fixed after first use; never a second spelling.
"The Group" is 本集团 and "the Company" is 本公司.
The Chinese keeps the measured tone of the English, in outlook statements above all (预计, 预期): no promotional, exaggerated or colloquial wording.
Dates as 2026年3月31日; financial periods as 截至2026年3月31日第一季度.
